description: This 3D model depicts a spiral staircase integrated into a modern table structure. The table has a square or rectangular top with rounded corners, and it appears to be made of a smooth, opaque material, possibly laminate or a solid surface. The legs of the table are substantial and have a somewhat abstract, angled design. The unique feature is the central opening in the tabletop, through which the spiral staircase descends. The staircase itself is constructed with wooden treads that have a light, natural finish, and a black central column. A black barrier with a curved wooden handrail runs along the edge of the opening on the tabletop, providing safety and a visually appealing contrast. The overall impression is one of contemporary design, blending functional furniture with architectural elements.
